name: PlsMark
tagline: Snip it, mark it up, paste it.
overview: PlsMark replaces the Screenshot, Paint, save, post loop with one small tool that is already running when you need it. Press Print Screen, drag a box over what you want, mark it up with a full set of drawing tools, and the finished picture lands on your clipboard. It is about 1 MB, works offline, needs no account, and makes no network calls.

capabilities.title: The snip screen
capabilities.text: The screen freezes and one big bar offers Photo, Video and GIF; Box, Window, Screen, Freeform, Scroll and Last area; Pick color, Grab text and Ruler.

proofs.caption: The snip bar over a frozen demo screen

capabilities.title: A snip box you can fix
capabilities.text: Draw the box roughly, then drag a corner or side to resize it, drag inside to move it, or drag outside for a new one. The size shows under the box.

proofs.caption: Box drawn around the chart, 706 x 640

capabilities.title: Mark it up, Bypass or Cancel
capabilities.text: After the snip, three equal buttons say what each one does: open the editor, copy the original picture, or throw the snip away.

proofs.caption: The three choices, each with a plain-words line

capabilities.title: Guides and Measure
capabilities.text: Full cross, Pointer cross (short or long), X, Y read-out and Measure, to line an edge up with something across the screen or measure a distance in px, mm and inches.

proofs.caption: Full cross, X, Y and Measure ticked: 629 px, 167 mm, 6.56 in

capabilities.title: Print Screen takes you there
capabilities.text: PlsMark sits by the clock and takes over Print Screen (or your own key), with an option to start with Windows.

capabilities.title: Window, Screen, Freeform, Last area
capabilities.text: Snip a whole window, a whole screen, a freehand shape, or the same area as last time.

capabilities.title: Scrolling capture
capabilities.text: Snip a page taller than the screen: PlsMark scrolls and stitches it into one picture.

capabilities.title: Video and GIF
capabilities.text: Record an area as an MP4 video with sound, or as a looping GIF.

capabilities.title: Pick color, Grab text, Ruler
capabilities.text: Read the color under the pointer, copy the text in a picture, or measure on screen.

capabilities.title: The markup editor
capabilities.text: Menu bar, capture bar, options row, labeled tool column, colors and layers, status bar, in light or dark.

capabilities.title: Pens, shapes and text
capabilities.text: Pen, highlighter, lines, arrows, boxes, ovals, shapes including ones you draw yourself, and text.

capabilities.title: Steps and stamps
capabilities.text: Numbered steps with looks and pointer lines, and a stamps library that remembers what you use.

capabilities.title: Blur and redact
capabilities.text: Blur or black out anything private before you share it.

capabilities.title: Magnifier callouts
capabilities.text: Zoom bubbles that call out a small detail.

capabilities.title: Layers, effects and adjustments
capabilities.text: Every mark is a layer; selections, crop, clone, fill, gradient, erase to see-through, effects, brightness and color adjustments, undo history.

capabilities.title: Grid, rulers and units
capabilities.text: Grid, rulers and px / in / mm units for exact work.

capabilities.title: Tabs, projects and search
capabilities.text: Several snips in tabs, .pmark projects that keep every layer, and a search box for any command.

capabilities.title: Auto shutter
capabilities.text: Timed captures every few seconds, with limits on count and folder.

capabilities.title: Finish to the clipboard
capabilities.text: The green check puts the finished picture on your clipboard, ready to paste; saving a file is optional.

capabilities.title: Small, offline, private
capabilities.text: About 1 MB. No network calls, no account, no ads, no telemetry.

note: Captured on a Windows 11 desktop at 2560 x 1440, shown at 1920 x 1080, over a demo screen (Sample Doc.pdf). No demo clip yet.
